item.title: Here’s how Newsom’s spending binge outstripped revenues, creating California’s chronic deficit
item.description: By Dan Walters, CalMatters This commentary was originally published by CalMatters. Sign up for their newsletters.An array of charts buried in the fine print of the state budget, unknown to all but a few fiscal nerds, details what California has collected in revenues and spent over the last half-century.

item.title: Malibu Council Moves to Extend Business-Friendly Event Permits
item.description: Malibu City Council voted Monday to explore making permanent a temporary ordinance that has streamlined business event permits since July 2025. The measure has helped 34 local businesses recover from the devastating Palisades Fire with zero complaints.

item.title: Artist Bobbie Rich Opens Third Solo Show at The Upper West
item.description: Santa Monica artist Bobbie Rich presents her third solo exhibition 'Earthly Delights' at The Upper West on Pico Blvd, with 20% of sales benefiting Feeding America. The opening reception is February 22 from 4:30-6:30pm.

item.title: LA County Adopts Heat Action Plan as Extreme Temperatures Kill 200+ Annually
item.description: Los Angeles County officials unanimously approved a comprehensive Heat Action Plan to combat extreme heat that kills over 200 residents annually. The plan prioritizes cooling outdoor spaces, improving indoor environments, and expanding public education about heat risks.

item.title: Factory-built housing hasn’t taken off in California yet, but this year might be different
item.description: Factory-built housing could finally gain momentum in California. Learn what’s changing in 2026, key challenges, and why the industry may take off now.

item.title: California Politburo
item.description: Santa Monica Daily Press columnist examines why LA politicians avoid challenging Mayor Bass, while local Santa Monica council members vote in lockstep.

item.title: Gale warning, thunderstorms threaten LA-area coast as powerful winter storm bears down on California
item.description: A gale warning and severe thunderstorm threats put the Los Angeles-area coastline on alert Monday as a powerful winter storm system began lashing California with heavy rain, high winds and the potential for dangerous flooding and debris flows.The National Weather Service issued a gale warning through 2 a.m.

item.title: City's Spring Recreation Guide Now Available
item.description: The City of Malibu's Spring 2026 Recreation Guide is now available online and will be mailed to residents the week of Feb. 9. Programs running March through May include swim lessons, wellness workshops, birding classes, and the 25th Annual Chumash Day Powwow.
